SELECT
  timestamp, iout, imag
FROM
  cryomag
ORDER BY
timestamp
DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp, vout, vmag
FROM
  cryomag
ORDER BY
timestamp
DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  sweep, mode, ps_heater
FROM
  cryomag
ORDER BY
timestamp
DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
ai_ci_ps as "Power supply electric current",
ia_v_hall as "V-Hall"
FROM
  shs
ORDER BY
timestamp
DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT timestamp, field as probe1 FROM field WHERE name = 'shs1' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT timestamp, field as probe2 FROM field WHERE name = 'shs2' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
ia_tcx01 as "TCX01 Upper Coil bobbin",
ia_tcx02 as "TCX02 Bottom Coil bobbin",
ia_tcx03 as "TCX03 HTS_2nd (+)_U cernox",
ia_tcx04 as "TCX04 HTS_2nd (-)_B cernox",
ia_tcx05 as "TCX05 Cold head #1 2nd stage",
ia_tcx06 as "TCX06 Cold head #2 2nd stage",
ia_tcx07 as "TCX07 Cold head #1 1st stage",
ia_tcx08 as "TCX08 Cold head #2 1st stage"
FROM
  shs
ORDER BY
timestamp
DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
ia_tsd09 as "TSD09 Thermal shield bottom plate",
ia_tsd10 as "TSD10 Thermal shield outside Silicon",
ia_tsd11 as "TSD11 HTS_1st(+)_U Silicon diodes",
ia_tsd12 as "TSD11 HTS_1st(-)_B Silicon diodes",
ai_tcc13 as "TCC13 Thermal shield top plate RH",
ai_tcc14 as "TCC14 Thermal shield inside RH",
ai_tcc15 as "TCC15 Thermal shield outside RH",
ai_tcc16 as "TCC16 Thermal shield bottom plate RH",
ai_tcc17 as "TCC17 Thermal shield top plate LH",
ai_tcc18 as "TCC18 Thermal shield inside LH",
ai_tcc19 as "TCC19 Thermal shield outside LH",
ai_tcc20 as "TCC20 Thermal shield bottom plate LH"
FROM
  shs
ORDER BY
timestamp
DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  time_bucket('5 minutes', "timestamp") AS "time",
  avg(ia_tcx01) AS ia_tcx01,
  avg(ia_tcx02) AS ia_tcx02,
  avg(ia_tcx03) AS ia_tcx03,
  avg(ia_tcx04) AS ia_tcx04,
  avg(ia_tcx05) AS ia_tcx05,
  avg(ia_tcx06) AS ia_tcx06,
  avg(ia_tcx07) AS ia_tcx07,
  avg(ia_tcx08) AS ia_tcx08,
  avg(ia_tsd09) AS ia_tsd09,
  avg(ia_tsd10) AS ia_tsd10,
  avg(ia_tsd11) AS ia_tsd11,
  avg(ia_tsd12) AS ia_tsd12,
  avg(ai_tcc13) AS ai_tcc13,
  avg(ai_tcc14) AS ai_tcc14,
  avg(ai_tcc15) AS ai_tcc15,
  avg(ai_tcc16) AS ai_tcc16,
  avg(ai_tcc17) AS ai_tcc17,
  avg(ai_tcc18) AS ai_tcc18,
  avg(ai_tcc19) AS ai_tcc19,
  avg(ai_tcc20) AS ai_tcc20
FROM shs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT timestamp, POWER(10, 2* (ch01_value - 6.5)) as "CC10 mag", POWER(10, 2 * (ch02_value -6.5)) as "CC10 mid" FROM gl840
WHERE ip_address LIKE 'logger1.%'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT timestamp, ch03_value as "Magnet", ch04_value as "Room" FROM gl840
WHERE ip_address LIKE 'logger1.%'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  avg(NULLIF((POWER(10, 2* (ch01_value - 6.5)))::float8, 'NaN')) AS "CC10 mag",
  avg(NULLIF((POWER(10, 2 * (ch02_value -6.5)))::float8, 'NaN')) AS "CC10 mid"
FROM gl840
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (ip_address LIKE 'logger1.%')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  avg(NULLIF((ch03_value)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "Magnet",
  avg(NULLIF((ch04_value)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "Room"
FROM gl840
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (ip_address LIKE 'logger1.%')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  avg(NULLIF((POWER(10, 2* (ch01_value - 6.5)))::float8, 'NaN')) AS "CC10 mag",
  avg(NULLIF((POWER(10, 2 * (ch02_value -6.5)))::float8, 'NaN')) AS "CC10 mid"
FROM gl840
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (ip_address LIKE 'logger1.%' OR ip_address LIKE '192.168.%')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),

SELECT
  time_bucket('5 minute', timestamp) AS minute,
  avg(ai_ci_ps) AS ai_ci_ps,
--  avg(ai_v_hall) AS ai_v_hall,
  avg(ia_v_hall) AS ia_v_hall
--  avg(ai_v_hall) AS ai_v_hall,
--  avg(ia_v_hall) AS ia_v_hall
FROM
  shs
WHERE
  timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY
  minute
ORDER BY
  minute

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  avg(NULLIF((field)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "probe1"
FROM field
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (name = 'shs1')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  avg(NULLIF((ABS(field))::float8, 'NaN')) AS "probe2"
FROM field
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (name = 'shs2')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  avg(NULLIF((ch01)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "v41",
  avg(NULLIF((ch02)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "v16",
  avg(NULLIF((ch03)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "v102",
  avg(NULLIF((ch05)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "v112",
  avg(NULLIF((ch07)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "v73",
  avg(NULLIF((ch08)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "v35",
  avg(NULLIF((ch09)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "v45-vtot",
  avg(NULLIF((ch10)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "vshunt",
  avg(NULLIF((ch11)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "vbl",
  avg(NULLIF((ch12)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "vps",
  avg(NULLIF((ch13)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "vhallx5",
  avg(NULLIF((ch15)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "cbi",
  avg(NULLIF((ch16)::float8, 'NaN')) AS "qdtrg"
FROM omniace
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
